original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished story environment for an otome 2.5D/3D character content package. Vertical portrait 9:16 image. Premium cinematic realistic 3D rendering, beautiful restrained textures, physically coherent room geometry, crisp details, soft natural lighting. No people, silhouettes, body parts, human reflections, text, titles, captions, logos, watermark or bottom lettering. No identifiable country, real city, brand or street address. Input image 1 is the spatial continuity master: use ONLY its upper-left bedroom, rendered from human eye level inside that room, not as a cutaway. Saturday morning in Rafael's modest renovated coastal-city apartment. Warm ivory walls, oak floor, wooden double bed with headboard against rear wall, off-white and gray linen with a dark olive blanket over lower half, broad black framed window on LEFT exterior wall with linen curtain, morning sunlight. Wooden bedside cabinet on RIGHT of bed, a small warm lamp, clear glass of drinking water and a dark smartphone resting screen down. A leafy plant near window, subtle framed landscape above bed. Camera near foot of bed, looking diagonally toward headboard while keeping a clear walking route on bed's right toward the bedroom doorway at front-right. Intimate lived-in but clean; a quiet morning, no coffee machine in bedroom, no alcohol, no wedding props. One continuous full-frame interior, no panels.
